purpose: Adapters for a bounded early Mantell slide case in New Zealand custody, a late-Victorian Birr Castle cabinet in the Irish national instrument inventory, and P. T. Cleve's original diatom-preparation corpus at the Swedish Museum of Natural History.
guards: Do not convert cabinet storage capacity into surviving slide count.
Preserve presentation, collection attribution, commercial preparation/supply and later institutional custody as separate relations.
Keep original/personal Cleve material distinct from replicated Cleve & Möller published sets held by multiple institutions.
For mixed late-nineteenth/early-twentieth-century cabinets, isolate the pre-1900 subset through labels, maker chronology or other dated object evidence before counting.

adapters.institution_scope: National Library of New Zealand Mantell family object collection
adapters.target: official Objects-0728 record for the ten-slide Mantell case
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the ten-slide bounded group, case initials, subject range and the explicit J. B. Reade-to-Mantell presentation relation; do not flatten presented slides into generic Mantell authorship.

adapters.institution_scope: Birr Castle microscope-slide cabinet in the Irish National Inventory of Historic Scientific Instruments
adapters.target: inventory item 2354 / BIR040 and any linked Birr object documentation
adapters.promotion_rule: Record cabinet dimensions, drawer structure and Watson labels while keeping the 19 x 16 slot capacity distinct from extant slide count; isolate 1882-1899 objects from the mixed late-19th/early-20th dating.

adapters.institution_scope: Swedish Museum of Natural History P. T. Cleve diatom collection
adapters.target: official NRM diatom collection page plus item/subcollection endpoint discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Recover Cleve-labelled microscope preparations and expedition-linked items; preserve processed/raw samples as separate media and keep this personal collection distinct from Cleve & Möller replicate sets.
